XenotypeDef.label: angel
XenotypeDef.description: Soldiers of Heaven inhabiting human vessels: winged, with eyes of cold light. Calm to the point of coldness, hard to wound and quick to heal, keenly attuned to psychic currents.
XenotypeDef.descriptionShort: Winged soldiers of Heaven with radiant eyes. Calm, resilient, fast-healing, psychically sensitive.
